Privacy and record boundaries

What account access stores

The account service handles your account email, email-code delivery, optional password/authenticator authentication and sessions. Plan records contain your account ID, plan, validity dates, status and an administrative purchase-verification reference. Plan assignment and revocation have an administrative change history. Only the designated owner can administer plan access after verified email-code sign-in or password plus authenticator verification.

Digital product test access

The ₹0 individual-guide simulator keeps account identifier, product, test-order reference and access dates temporarily in server memory. Restarting the service clears those individual-guide test records. Individual-guide choices and personal review reminders stay in the browser tab; recovery files are read locally and are never uploaded. No personal case review or human consultation is provided by these digital products.

Test orders and payment information

Navigator’s staging plan orders and personalised checklist orders retain account, order and payment references and access or delivery metadata. Plan orders also retain assigned seats and access dates. Razorpay handles the payment fields shown in its checkout. Navigator does not ask for your card number, PIN or payment credentials. Live payments are currently closed.

Account and order records support sign-in, order verification, access, security and support. Hosting, sign-in, email and payment providers process information needed for their services. Use the support and grievance desk to request a correction or raise a privacy concern. Never email inquiry records or passwords. Razorpay privacy policy

What the inquiry guide does

Procedural selections, dates, reviewer codes and document preparation are processed in the open browser session. Navigator has no case-upload or case-save endpoint. Do not enter party identities, testimony, confidential narratives or evidence contents. Keep original records in your institution’s own authorised system.

The optional file-fingerprint tool reads selected files locally to calculate SHA-256 values. It does not upload them. A fingerprint does not prove authenticity, admissibility or lawful collection.

Downloads and local retention

Word drafts, full-session recovery files, timeline exports, fingerprints and calendar files are downloads you initiate. They may remain in your device’s download folder or another location you choose. Your institution controls their protection, retention and deletion. Calendar imports are handled by the calendar service you select, with its own settings and privacy arrangements.

Closing or reloading the guide clears its in-memory session. Save a full recovery file first to retain recorded workflow answers, document progress and timeline history. Resume reads and validates the selected file locally and requires confirmation before replacing the current tab. Recovery files are readable JSON, not encrypted backups; they exclude downloaded Word files and selected evidence files. Supported unfinished timeline and document-reference fields are retained as drafts, never automatically submitted. Older timeline-only exports restore dates/history and restart questions at P01. Exports do not create a shared or tamper-proof institutional audit record. A draft download is not legal service, a filing, a finding or proof of compliance.

Authentication and hosting

Authentication and hosting providers may keep normal security and operational logs, including account sign-in activity and network information. “No case database” does not mean that no account or hosting records exist. Provider sessions are carried in an encrypted, HttpOnly browser cookie. Case selections are not included in account requests.

Requests and support

Use your verified plan-provider contact for account correction, access revocation, authenticator recovery or deletion requests. Give your account ID and general account issue only. Never send complaint files or evidence for account support. Plan expiry blocks access; it does not automatically delete your account or previously downloaded files.
